    Species to plant in each cut pixel

    historicHarvestPlantingTable.Rd

    For each cut pixel, every species whose cover in speciesLayers is above minCoverThreshold and that has maxB in the pixel's ecoregion.

    historicHarvestPlantingTable(
  cutPixels,
  speciesLayers,
  ecoregionMap,
  speciesEcoregion,
  currentTime,
  minCoverThreshold,
  speciesCodeLevels
)

    Arguments

    cutPixels

    Integer. Pixel indices (cells of ecoregionMap) that were cut.

    speciesLayers

    SpatRaster of percent cover, one layer per species, named by species code, on the same grid as ecoregionMap.

    ecoregionMap

    Categorical SpatRaster with an ecoregionGroup category.

    speciesEcoregion

    The speciesEcoregion table of Biomass_core.

    currentTime

    Numeric. Selects the latest speciesEcoregion year at or before it.

    minCoverThreshold

    Numeric. Percent cover a species must exceed.

    speciesCodeLevels

    Character. Levels for the speciesCode factor (those of cohortData).

    Value

    A data.table with pixelIndex, speciesCode and ecoregionGroup; no rows if nothing is to be planted.
